title: Application crashes when adding a third event to a new program
description: The application crashes when attempting to add a third lighting event while creating a new program. This occurs after successfully adding two events.
steps: Open the application.
Tap on '+ CREATE SCHEDULE'.
Enter 'Program K' as the program name and tap 'Next'.
Select all days of the week and tap 'Next'.
Select 'Sunset' for the event timing and tap 'Next'.
Select '30 min before sunset' and tap 'Next'.
Tap the dropdown arrow for 'Themes'.
Select 'Theme 20' and tap 'Next'.
Select 'On' for the light action and tap 'Next'.
Tap '+ Add Event'.
Select 'Specific Time' for the event timing and tap 'Next'.
Enter '12' for hours, '00' for minutes, and select 'AM'. Tap 'Next'.
Tap the dropdown arrow for 'Groups'.
Select 'All Lights' and tap 'Next'.
Adjust the 'Intensity' slider and select 'No' for color control. Tap 'Next'.
Tap '+ Add Event'.
Select 'Sunrise' for the event timing and tap 'Next'.
Select '90 min before sunrise' and tap 'Next'.
Tap the dropdown arrow for 'Themes'.
Select 'Theme 20' and tap 'Next'.
Select 'On' for the light action and tap 'Next'.
actual: The application crashes after attempting to add the third event.
expected: The user should be able to successfully add the third event and proceed with creating the program.
